editorial:
Imagine a world where the most powerful man on Earth is seen as a threat instead of a hero. You get to see a gritty, older Batman who is tired of everything and thinks Superman is too dangerous to be left alone. The vibe is dark and heavy, focusing on the clash between these two icons. You will feel the tension build as they go from hating each other to realizing they have a much bigger problem to deal with. It is less like a typical comic book movie and more like a serious drama with giant explosions.

The action scenes are huge and look great, and the fight between the two leads is something you cannot miss. While the story can feel a bit rushed or confusing in the middle, the spectacle makes up for it. If you love big superhero battles, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail, or rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a huge fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After Batman and Superman team up, they fight a monster called Doomsday. Superman realizes the only way to stop the beast is to use a powerful spear, but it kills him in the process. He dies saving the world, which makes Batman realize that Superman was a true hero. The movie ends with a hint that Superman might come back to life and a tease about other heroes joining together to form a team.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark superhero stories and massive fight scenes.
